claim: Apparatus preceded the work it was apparatus for: an ignore file, a manifest, a test runner and a generator script are all present on the tree's first day, and CI one day later.
falsified_by: a test runner or manifest in this tree dated before 2026-08-29 under the excluded deps/ path or under a filename the apparatus detector does not recognise, or a first-day test runner that ran nothing, which the detector cannot distinguish from one that ran something
scope: Covers the presence and date of four apparatus files and one CI file. Says nothing about whether any job ran, passed, or checked anything.

claim: Endings are carried out in the tree rather than only asserted: a child project that stopped shows as a prefix going quiet with its replacement appearing the same day, and a relocation that was reversed shows as files moving twice.
falsified_by: a later pin in which the tools/apodeixis prefix resumes commits, or in which the anoieu_fuzz files move back into tools, which would make anoieu-death-0022 and anoieu-transplant-0002 pauses rather than endings
scope: Two endings inside one four-day window. It does not cover whether either ending was the right call, and one-day lifetimes are too short to generalise from.

claim: A child project was created and retired within a single day, and the replacement register entry names different work for the same slot.
falsified_by: tools/apodeixis resuming commits in a later pin, which would make this a pause; or the two prefixes turning out to be unrelated work that happened to land on the same day, which the detectors cannot rule out since they see prefixes and not intent
scope: One prefix in one day. The reason for the retirement is taken from the declared record, not derived; the tree shows the retirement and not its cause.

claim: Every governing document in this tree was revised harder on the day it was created than on any day after: the reporting policy six times in its first day, the vision by 740 lines in its first day, the roles inventory seven times and 1,209 lines in its first day.
falsified_by: a governance_lines threshold of 40 being low enough that ordinary same-day editing clears it, which would make this a fact about the threshold rather than about the documents — testable by re-running with a threshold at 200 and seeing whether the pattern survives
scope: Line counts of revisions to three files over four days. It says nothing about whether the revisions improved the documents, and same-day revision is the expected shape of any document written in one sitting across several commits.

claim: The ratio of prose lines to tool lines moved from 1.16 in the August window to 6.46 in the September window of the same tree.
falsified_by: the 2026-09 row covering a single day, so one prose-heavy day inverts it; a later pin with a full September would settle it, and until then this is two points of which one is a single day
scope: Two month buckets over a four-day history, one of which is one day. The subject declares prose to be its product, so the absolute ratio is not comparable across subjects; only the movement within this tree is claimed.

claim: This tool's delta produced exactly one match on this subject and it is a word collision, reproducing on a second subject the failure mode the first run reported about itself.
falsified_by: a reading of C0010 on which the topic really is about the tools prefix rather than about re-running tools, which would make the match correct and this assessment wrong
scope: A finding about this tool, not about the subject. It is the reason Q2 and Q3 are held in reduced form and it does not bear on Q1, Q4 or Q5.
